access_links.label: Dataset page on the European data portal

description: Zemljevid verjetnosti pojavljanja plazov is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapserver.geo-zs.si. Karta podaja potencialna plazovita območja za območje celotne Slovenije v šestih razredih verjetnosti pojavljanja plazov; ni verjetnosti, zelo majhna verjetnost, majhna verjetnost, srednja verjetnost, velika verjetnost, zelo velika verjetnost. Zanesljivost napovedi je približno 0,88. Coverage: SI. The portal shows the English title as "Landslide susceptibility map" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include INSPIRE, inženirska geologija, matematični model, geology, Slovenia, landslide. The listing shows 2006-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
